hose_stiffness_6V6.statement: re-routed coil (CAD v3.4.1): pressurised hose EI <= 0.25 N m2, i.e. K_max <= 23.4 N m/rad (scalar at the largest eigenvalue of the coupled K, including any other line across the gimbal), flown at the 6.6 V degraded plug without a loss by the decision rule on both actuator methods; EI 0.5 (K 46.7) loses at 6.6 V and at 7.4 V on both methods. The lead criterion K_max <= 17.2 N m/rad at 7.4 V is stricter and is supported. B-FD-1 measures the pressurised EI: its upper bound must not exceed 0.25 N m2
hose_stiffness_6V6.point_format: (EI N m2, K N m/rad, [command slew deg/s,] lost, gained, p) pooled A1 + B1 62 m, 1000 paired runs

drogue_release_rule.rule: release the drogue at E2 AND [measured Pc >= 3.0 bar abs OR the >= 0.8 bar rise held continuously until E2 + 0.10 s]
drogue_release_rule.note: plateau = Combustion fuel-starved start 2.4-3.6 bar abs for 0.1-0.4 s; no plateau arm loses P against the decided rule without a plateau; the branch is P-neutral against waiting for 3.0 bar; its value is the bounded hold

fc_implementation.tag: DESIGN (GNC mapping of the LEAD rule onto the Electronics v2.9 telemetry; firmware v2.9 SIL only, not flown in hardware)
fc_implementation.frame: TLM_FAST CAN 0x100 ECU->FC, 500 Hz, len 8: d0 seq; d1 = state in b0-b3 (EVERY FC decoder masks d1 & 0x0F; the unmasked byte is no longer the state) + flags b4 E2 of this start, b5 rise now (firmware v2.9: filtered AND raw >= P0 + 0.8 bar), b6 rise held since E2 (cleared at the first tick without it, stays clear for the start), b7 rise held to E2 + kDrogueRiseHold_s 0.10 s (latched); d2-d3 Pc u16 kPa abs (0xFFFF = invalid, RG-15); d4-d5 pintle lift; d6-d7 fault bits incl. PC_SENSOR. LEAD 2026-10-13 (CHANGELOG, after the Combustion drogue-hold check): the hold (b6/b7) is evaluated on the FILTERED channel only, E2 keeps filtered AND raw; to be implemented when Electronics resumes (firmware v2.9 still uses filtered AND raw for the hold)
fc_implementation.predicate: while the drogue is attached in the A relight, on each new TLM_FAST frame (sequence advanced): RELEASE iff b4 AND [(d2-d3 != 0xFFFF AND d2-d3 >= 300 kPa abs) OR b7]; b5 and b6 are logged, not used; the decision is latched (one release command, never re-attached)
fc_implementation.e2_source: b4 is set in the frame of the RUN entry; the E2 time is EVENT 0x120 STATE (RUN entry) t_ms
fc_implementation.sil_evidence: Electronics SIL A1 relight (firmware v2.9, N 273 lit): rise held to E2 + 0.10 s in 273/273; E2 -> Pc 3.0 bar abs p50/p95/max 3/34/43 ms; E2 16-18 ms after the light (LEAD 2026-10-13: accepted); the SIL plant has no fuel-starved plateau
fc_implementation.sim6_equivalence: sim6 rel_mode 1 + rel_to 0.10: E2 at the 6-DOF light (rel_dt 0), i.e. 16-18 ms EARLIER than the firmware; release bracket: +100 ms pooled -4/+4, +200 ms -11/+5 (p 0.21), +400 ms -21/+6 (p 0.0059) -> the 16-18 ms offset is inside the P-neutral bracket. Rise in sim6 = truth Pc-equivalent thrust >= rel_Frise (P0 = 1.313 bar abs ASSUMED); in firmware v2.9 the hold uses filtered AND raw over the measured P0, so roughness or a dip clears b6/b7 and the release falls back on the 3.0 bar branch (the LEAD filtered-only decision removes the raw-channel path); that direction is bounded by arm L400_nto (branch off; pooled -13/+6 p 0.167 vs the decided rule without plateau; branch on vs off -10/+12 p 0.832). Combustion drogue_hold_check_v2p4 (70820e0038be39a7, SIM quasi-steady, 288 lit corners): rise >= 0.8 bar held from E2 to E2 + 0.10 s on every lit corner, min margin 0.74 bar (0.48 bar with the torch +0.3 bar in the baseline only); no unlit case reaches 0.8 bar (max 0.51); worst corner (fuel-starved A1 relight) Pc 2.60-2.62 bar abs, between the flown plateau arms L (2.4 bar) and M (2.9 bar), neither of which loses; roughness tolerance 0.48 bar zero-to-peak, unmeasured until IGN-1/T1
fc_implementation.open_item: Pc channel invalid inside [E2, release] (window <= 43 ms in SIL, up to 0.10 s on a plateau): neither branch can complete and the drogue stays attached while the engine runs; the decided rule does not define this case and sim6 has no Pc-invalid model in the release logic -> fault arm required (RG-15 extension); no value is proposed here

sources.lead: interfaces/CHANGELOG.md 2026-10-13 lead decisions on the release rule, on the Electronics handback ((4) E2 latency accepted, (6) d1 mask) and on the filtered-only hold bit

relight_planner.statement: do NOT add the start plateau to the relight planning value: t_ign_est + 0.3 s LOSES (pooled)

purge_trigger_gate.finding: prg_T 3.0 s: 6 of 500 runs start the purge 10.15-10.54 s into the flight at h 301-304 m (drogue deployment) because the trigger extrapolates h and v over lag + prg_T + prg_lead with the measured acceleration (about -g just after deployment); duration up to 13.9 s, purge mass up to 278 g; all 6 landed
purge_trigger_gate.gate: evaluate the extended purge trigger only once the drogue descent is quasi-steady (|a_z,est - a_drogue| small for a hold time, or t >= t_drogue + settle), use constant velocity beyond the plain lag, and cap the purge duration at prg_T + margin; to be flown before the purge sequence is frozen

mass_budget_rg16.statement: with the adopted estimator (rocket-equation Pc-lost rule + lever/direction compensation) every case keeps the held maximum <= 593.9 N (margin >= 56 N to 650 N) and misses no 670 N stuck case; the stuck-open bleed is a FAULT outside the nominal budget (no FSW model, no detector)

launch_commit_proposal.rule: W10 < 6.0 m/s AND sigma_u(3 m) <= 1.0 m/s
launch_commit_proposal.sensor: anemometer at 3.0 m above the pad (sonic or fast cup); W10 from the 3 m mean by the power law alpha 0.14 or a 10 m mast
launch_commit_proposal.averaging: mean and standard deviation over the 10 min before ARM (LITERATURE convention for mean wind and turbulence intensity, e.g. IEC 61400-1 10-min sigma); the 6-DOF imposes sigma_u as the Dryden intensity, so the equivalence of the two is a model-form ASSUMPTION

cap_rule_proposal.rule:
Rule (PROPOSAL for the lead, to be re-applied per engine after T1-T4):
  inputs  k = delivered thrust per propellant flow relative to the map (T1-T4 load cell / flow), u_k its 1-sigma;
          (a, n) regression law with its 2-sigma region; g = throat growth per flight with u_g; N2O load 2.00 kg.
  corner  k_c = k - 2 u_k; (a_c, n_c) = the 2-sigma point with the lowest regression (low a, high n: the longest burn and
          the largest N2O use); g_c = g + 2 u_g.
  cap     h_cap = the largest grid height (0.25 m steps from H_LO) such that EVERY grid height up to it meets the +25 %
          reserve rule (usable N2O = liquid left - 3 % trapped >= 25 % of the N2O burned) on the nominal flight at the
          corner with the flight FSW. Grid, not bisection: reserve(h) is a step function of the 10 ms MECO quantisation
          (RG-11 b).
  check   conditional MC at h_cap with (k_c, a_c, n_c, g_c) fixed in every run and every other dispersion drawn (seed 101,
          500 runs): P >= 0.99 and no exhausted run; otherwise lower h_cap by 0.25 m and repeat.

fsw_record.as_flown_note: v1.4: FSW of run 0 of each relight-path study arm, built by the study's own code; the release, start-transient and purge-cost arms fly the stored v2.8 FSW (mest_mode 0, kest_comp 0, fct_comp 0) and are paired with comparators on that same FSW; m2_purge_bleed flies the flown-mass-estimator FSW without fct_comp. Studies not listed here name their base in their own script docstring

relight_planning_source.ecu_input: TLM_RELIGHT CAN 0x102 ECU->FC, 50 Hz in every state: d2 flags PRIMED b0 (= DIRECT_PATH; NOT a vapour detector), VALID b1, READY b2, LOCKOUT b3, S1_FAULT b4, STAND b5, POST_ABORT b6, UNKNOWN b7; states NONE (VALID 0), PRIMED, UNPRIMED, UNKNOWN
relight_planning_source.fc_mapping: frame fresh (age <= 0.3 s ASSUMED, 15 frames at 50 Hz) with CRC and sequence valid and VALID = 1: PRIMED -> 0.81 s; PRIMED = 0 -> 1.41 s; VALID = 0 or no fresh frame -> the gnc.json v3 stale_or_missing_flag rule (hold the last valid flag since the MECO valve closure; none -> 0.81 s); evaluated every frame, latched at T_fire
relight_planning_source.proposal_unknown_state: PROPOSAL (GNC, not flown): UNKNOWN (b7) -> 1.41 s, because the ECU takes the prep path in that state (electronics.json v2 relight_interface.fault_path: 'prep (P_feed invalid, UNKNOWN)', command -> E2 0.90-0.98 s on the 13.5/19.0 cm3 slugs); Electronics to confirm the path; LEAD decision
relight_planning_source.purge: pre-scheduled purge (LEAD 2026-10-13): ends before T_fire, so the plan stays 0.81 s on the direct path (Electronics SIL: command -> E2 0.19 s after a pre-scheduled purge); its N2O cost is flown in m2_purge_cost v1

purge_cost_A1_reserve.tag: SIM (bounding: the modelled purge runs 2.6-3.4 s to the lift, the ECU's pre-scheduled purge 2.5 s)
purge_cost_A1_reserve.decision: LEAD 2026-10-13 on the Electronics handback (1): PURGE PRE-SCHEDULED (ends before T_fire), 0.81 s plan holds; GNC flies the purge N2O cost (~76 g at 1.0 mm, ~50 g at 0.8 mm) in the A1 reserve; vent balanced or axial
purge_cost_A1_reserve.reserve_statement: decided rule without purge: liquid left at touchdown min 114.1 g (A1_none) / 123.7 g (A1J_pc) including the unusable 3 % (ASSUMED, about 59 g), i.e. 55-65 g usable in the worst of 500 draws; the two lowest-reserve draws (runs 14 and 108) exhaust with the 1.0 mm purge and survive a 50 g purge with >= 5 g usable left; the 0.8 mm bleed (~50 g) fits the A1 reserve, the 1.0 mm bleed (~76 g) exhausts 2/500 per base (P-neutral by the decision rule; the combination with the 0.4 s start plateau is pooled -11/+3, p 0.057, within 1 %: near the loss threshold)
